name: Cubed Heist
source:
Your cube friend has invited you to breakfast to talk about her boring life in the city, and what she’s going to do to change that.

[From [url=https://mintburrow.itch.io/cubella]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的方块朋友邀请你共进早餐，想聊聊她在城里无聊的生活，以及她打算如何改变这一切。

[摘自[url=https://mintburrow.itch.io/cubella]Itch.io[/url]]
